description: System maintenance activities are not performed according to documented procedures or schedules. This signal indicates that maintenance may be ad-hoc, undocumented, or performed without proper authorization.
applicability: Applicable to all organizational systems requiring maintenance. Includes scheduled maintenance, emergency repairs, and routine servicing of hardware and software components.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through maintenance procedure review, maintenance log analysis, and scheduled maintenance verification.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
